name: stress-ng zlib
description: Start N workers compressing and decompressing random data using zlib. Each worker has two processes, one that compresses random data and pipes it to another process that decompresses the data. This stressor exercises CPU, cache and memory. The score is the total bogo operations per second (in real time) based on wall clock run time.

environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
